rationale: R14 M2 carve under the D3 boundary: the component inspector, EditorBridge, the StateStore HostParamSurface adapter and the runtime-inspector bridge move from pulp-view-core and pulp-view-script into the Pulp-kept pulp-view-tooling target, behind view-core seams (view_type_name, host_surfaces.hpp, ScriptInspectorPort). The waveform editor geometry moves into pulp-view-audio. No design-import, Chromium, rendering or packaging behavior changes, and no implementation authority moves.
